comment_purpose: The Git Crafter Process page's other tabs as data: CI, Testing, Claude, Tokens and Systems, and ideals: each tab's ideal state, keyed by tab id. The process maps are each repo's own: Git Crafter's are in maps.json, a repo names its own file in its config (docs.maps).

build.ideal: A process is a map of at most six steps where quality, speed and consumption are decided, each scored by one Quality metric.

ci.ideal: Every repo runs one CI standard on hosted runners, pinned to a SHA, and skips unchanged work so included minutes last the month.

sources.title: GitHub: about billing for GitHub Actions

testing.ideal: Many fast unit tests, fewer broad ones, few end-to-end; every suite runs in CI on every PR, and main stays green.

sources.title: Martin Fowler: The Practical Test Pyramid

claude.ideal: One agent loop works with skills loaded on demand; a subagent must earn its place, and the cheapest passing model does each job.

sources.title: Claude docs: choosing the right model
Anthropic: when to fold subagents into your main agent loop

tokens.ideal: Each session keeps a stable prompt prefix so most input reads from cache, subagents return short results, and tokens per merged change fall.

sources.title: Claude Code: how Claude Code uses prompt caching
Anthropic: when to fold subagents into your main agent loop

systems.ideal: Each outside system is mapped with its limits, read live and dated; use stays under 80%, and a failed read is not measured.

sources.title: GitHub: rate limits for the REST API
GitHub: about billing for GitHub Actions

claude.comment: The Claude tab: usage, model routes, which model, when to delegate, and who decides what, read from rules/delegation.md at build time.

routes.label: Claude Opus 5.5
routes.tip: Orchestrator and worker sessions, each in its own worktree: plan, build, merge

routes.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
routes.tip: One reviewer subagent per round with a shell, and well-specified work

routes.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
routes.tip: Searches and CI logs through the built-in Explore agent with model haiku; Claude Code questions through claude-code-guide

routes.label: Open-weight models
routes.tip: Bulk text on free models: OpenRouter, Ollama cloud

models.comment: The Which model table: the work, the model and effort Anthropic's docs point to, each with its source. A row's tip carries the doc's words or figures; checked 2026-11-03.

rows.tip: Most workloads start with Claude Opus 5.5 (model selection matrix); medium is its default effort
Sonnet 5.5 defaults to high; for agentic coding and multistep tool use, the effort doc says to start with medium for well-specified tasks
high suits complex reasoning and difficult coding problems (effort levels table); Opus for these reviews is the orchestrator's call, 2026-11-03
Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a prompt over 100,000 tokens pays $0.50 per million input tokens against $0.10 (pricing page)
Terminal-Bench 4.0: 39.2% for Haiku 5.5 against 70.6% for Sonnet 5.5 (anthropic.com); Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 remain the better choices for complex agentic coding
If evals at xhigh or max effort still fall short on demanding reasoning or long-horizon agentic work, move to Fable 5.1; high is its default

delegate.comment: The When to delegate map: one loop by default, the conditions that earn a subagent or session, how to split, and the lighter model. Each node shows the first of its metrics from data/org.json, rated against that metric's own goal; a node with an empty list reads no metric yet. ref names the source when it is not the article.
delegate.source_label: Anthropic: when to fold subagents into your main agent loop (2026-10-22)

default.label: One loop
default.tip: The orchestrator does the work itself; skills and path-scoped rules load on demand

branches.label: Parallel work
branches.tip: Tasks run in parallel, each in a fresh context it can discard: the app's sessions, each in its own worktree

branches.label: Context bloat
branches.tip: One loop degrades measurably from context bloat: context per call over its goal; the Explore agent on Haiku reads, and returns the answer

branches.label: Tool or rule conflict
branches.tip: One agent struggles to pick tools, or its instructions conflict

branches.label: Independent read
branches.tip: A security or guard review, read apart from the work: one reviewer subagent on Sonnet with a shell

how.label: Split by context
how.tip: Not by problem type: each handoff loses detail

how.label: Compact result
how.tip: Work that needs little from the rest, and a short result back

how.label: Turn and cost budgets
how.tip: The loop runs until it answers or hits a budget

light.label: Lighter model
light.tip: A lighter Claude model takes small, bounded work: the Agent call names model haiku or sonnet, since built-in agents otherwise run on the session's model

ci.comment: The CI tab's standard: how much of the org's included Actions minutes are used and left (the Credits tab's credits.actions_pool_used). templates/ci/README.md holds the rules and the metric definitions.
